blocking_gate.first_mutation_boundary: existing H2/S1-C1 producer first owned mutation is testset b[0x01c465bd]; any gate must precede it
blocking_gate.reason: The exact live producer ABI evidence proves LR/rets identity is the necessary discriminator, but the currently admitted PI32 instruction evidence used by this project has no exact validated encoding to read or compare the special rets register before testset. Building a candidate without the LR part would violate the critical invariant.
blocking_gate.requirement: Producer must accept private publication only on exact direct route LR/rets == 0x0201e46c AND r9 == 0xa3 before any lock/state/slot mutation; segmented and every other caller must reject without mutation.

forbidden_outputs: uploader that can send live traffic

host_sender_dry_run.send_policy: No live send path is enabled in this BLOCK. Packet hashes are reproducible only for review.

producer_state_machine_required.first_exact_direct: state EMPTY -> LOADING, copy slot0, note0=36, valid0=1
producer_state_machine_required.later_exact_direct: reject without mutation once ARMED or valid1 present
producer_state_machine_required.second_exact_direct: state LOADING and valid0=1 and valid1=0 -> copy slot1, note1=45, valid1=1, ARMED last
producer_state_machine_required.segmented_or_other: reject without lock/state/slot mutation before testset

scope: official-v15-only offline BLOCK; no device access, no flash, no OTA, no reset, no live MIDI traffic

selector_design.state_model: EMPTY compatibility, LOADING fallback, ARMED two-slot selector with explicit selected-valid rechecks
